answer: PoA blocks Sybil farms with a per-identity staked attestation quota: each verified human may submit only a fixed number of attestations per epoch, each bonded and slashable. A farm must stake separately per clone and pay verification, gas, and review costs, so every marginal clone costs more than the reward it can earn. Cross-review also pays honest humans to flag clusters, so a fake tundra of cheap identities drains the operator while a river of real reputation rewards only surviving accounts, and an oasis of verified truth stays costly to fake.
